title: Boring!
body: Game is so boring! You don’t have control over your player, just upgrading stats and clicking “Next” to either have the game simulated or clicking through an offseason that ends when it wants to. When your stamina runs out, you have to either spend diamonds or leave the game open for hours to get it to fill up. No, the stamina doesn’t fill up while the app is closed. Also, SEVEN HOURS FOR THE SEASON COOLDOWN?? Before starting a new season, you have to wait 7 hours for the cooldown. That’s after clicking “Next” through a boring offseason. You can also spend diamonds to skip but it’s 200 diamonds. Worst “football” game to ever exist!

title: Really Want to Like
body: Game isn’t exactly as advertised in ads. I came expecting in-game playability or some level of control. There’s also no way to view stats to see how you stack up with other teams, and no modifiers that seem to give teams an advantage so winning seems random, and somehow I’m always on a losing team. With no stat cap, there’s no way to tell which stats are helping your team the most. And once you go pro, you’re making so much money it becomes obselete. Maybe some way to use the money to purchase more training or stats, or the cheerleaders, shards, tactics, etc. I see the potential here. Hope for some updates soon.

title: Stat tracking
body: I just had a semi finals playoff win and didn’t get advance. That needs to be fixed asap. The game is fun, it would be cool to have a little control over what plays are ran. The stat tracking needs a major overhaul, as a running back none of the stats ever make sense. My latest game I had 10 caries for 10 yards, a longest run of 41 yards. And an average yards per carry of 4 yard. That’s impossible to have mathematically. I should have averaged 1 yards per carry as I only had 10 and went 10 yards. And a longest run of 41 yard then only having 10 total yards would imply that I was running backwards half the time. Also the way xp is rewarded seems like it has nothing to do with in game stats. I’ve had games where there were zeros across the board and I got more xp then games where I had stats.
